idea-plugin.name: MiniMessage-formatter
idea-plugin.description:
Syntax highlighting for MiniMessage color tags in Java and Kotlin code.

Features

  • Real-time preview of MiniMessage color tags in string literals
  • Support for named colors (red, blue, white, etc.)
  • Support for hex colors (#FF5533)
  • Full gradient tag support with smooth color transitions
  • Customizable color mappings through settings panel
  • Kotlin string templates resolve constants and helper functions, so "${ACCENT}text" shows in the color ACCENT holds
  • Java concatenations such as Messages.ACCENT + "text", and YAML config values
  • <palette:name> tags read from a val PALETTE = mapOf(...) in your code
  • Bold, italic, underlined and strikethrough shown in the editor
  • Gutter color swatches with a color picker
  • Hover preview of a message the way it looks in chat
  • Tag completion, and warnings for mistyped tags and mismatched placeholders
  • Legacy &a / §a color codes
  • Add your own custom color names

Supported Formats

  • Named colors: <red>text</red>
  • Hex colors: <#FF5533>text</#FF5533>
  • Verbose format: <color:red>text</color>
  • Gradients: <gradient:#A3ADFF:#00FFF4>text</gradient>
  • Rainbow: <rainbow>text</rainbow>, <rainbow:!>reversed</rainbow>, <rainbow:2>text</rainbow>

Usage

The plugin automatically highlights MiniMessage color tags in Java and Kotlin string literals. Configure custom color mappings in Settings → Tools → MiniMessage Colors.

Perfect for Minecraft plugin developers and anyone working with the MiniMessage text formatting library.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
2.0.0

  • Kotlin string templates color from the constants and helper functions they use, e.g. "${Messages.ERROR}text" and ${num("<amount>")}.
  • <palette:name> tags, read from a val PALETTE = mapOf(...) in your code.
  • Java concatenations and YAML config values are colored.
  • Bold, italic, underlined and strikethrough show in the editor.
  • Gutter color swatches with a color picker.
  • Hover a message to preview it the way it looks in chat.
  • Completion for every standard tag and its arguments: click and hover actions, colors, keybinds, pride flags, fonts and selectors. </ offers the innermost open tag, and placeholders already used come up too.
  • Warnings for bad hex colors, mistyped tags, unknown palette names and stray closing tags.
  • An inspection for send(...) calls whose placeholders don't match the message.
  • Legacy §a and &a codes (&a can be turned off in settings).
  • Fixed: closing tags such as </bold> end only their own tag instead of the color around it.
  • Fixed: gradients spread over the visible text only, not the tags inside them.
  • Fixed: <!shadow> is no longer reported as an unknown decoration.

1.0.2

  • 2025-11-22: Added support for <rainbow> tags with reversed and phase arguments.
  • 2025-11-20: Renamed plugin from Mini-message-format-viewer to MiniMessage-formatter.
